description: Get Purchase Orders UIView. Part of the Get All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: purchaseDate. Optional.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint for invoice list queries. Default: 10. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.
